objective: Make euf-viper the independently validated leader for QF_UF without external fallback, benchmark-identity routing, or unchecked answers, while preserving a differentiated structural and proof-reconfigurable architecture.

comparators.pinning: Every executable, source revision, argument vector, environment, and version output is hash-bound before timing.

score_policy.coverage_index: 100 * candidate_solved / maximum_solver_solved, aggregated only across complete comparable panels
score_policy.primary_performance_index: geometric mean of panel PAR2 indices after validity and coverage floors pass
score_policy.common_speed_index: geometric mean of common-solved geometric-time indices
score_policy.resource_index: geometric mean of RSS and instruction indices where complete measurements exist
score_policy.no_compensation_rule: A composite score cannot hide a wrong answer, coverage loss, missing panel, certificate failure, or failed holdout.
score_policy.world_leader_label: Allowed only when all V0 through V6 gates pass; otherwise the dashboard must say provisional, targeted leader, or not leader.

technical_lanes.name: measurement_and_dashboard
technical_lanes.next_falsifier: Recompute the frozen broad analysis and current structural scouts into one revision-isolated dashboard.
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: Every displayed number is source-bound and no incompatible panel is aggregated.

technical_lanes.name: fast_head_and_front_end
technical_lanes.next_falsifier: WMI job 170902 plus parse/encode/search stage counters on lineage-balanced hot-400.
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: At least 1.05x common geometric speed with no coverage loss and anti-target p95 at most 1.01x.

technical_lanes.name: Goel_and_general_Boolean_EUF
technical_lanes.next_falsifier: Complete source-stable learning and compare on the frozen 22-deficit panel with same-binary controls.
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: Convert at least one Yices-only solve, beat Yices2 on target inclusive time, and keep hot-400 p95 at most 1.01x.

technical_lanes.name: canonical_quotient_frontier
technical_lanes.next_falsifier: Measure exact full-key repetition, avoided work, and key construction cost without behavior changes.
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: At least 20% exact useful repetition, at least 5% corpus-time relevance, and key cost below 10% of avoided work.

technical_lanes.name: proof_system_compilation
technical_lanes.next_falsifier: Produce one independently replayed nontrivial proof DAG or a checked empty clause under frozen work and memory caps.
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: Beat generic factoring and Yices2 by at least 1.05x on the target, then pass full no-regression gates.

technical_lanes.name: finite_and_discrete_native_search
technical_lanes.next_falsifier: Repeat current family gains on Helios and unseen generated sizes before adding another finite mechanism.
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: Coverage dominance, at least 1.05x common geometric over Yices2, and independently checked models/proofs.

technical_lanes.name: semantic_symmetry
technical_lanes.next_falsifier: Find a replay-valid second-round semantic cut absent from one-shot typed and generic SORB controls.
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: At least 1.10x target PAR2 with proof replay and anti-target p95 at most 1.01x.

technical_lanes.name: modern_SAT_backend_and_inprocessing
technical_lanes.next_falsifier: Identical-CNF backend Williams comparison with model/proof checks.
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: End-to-end gain on two CPU classes; clause counts alone do not pass.

technical_lanes.name: certification_and_trust
technical_lanes.next_falsifier: Full-corpus shadow with independently reconstructed base CNF and zero unchecked decisive rows.
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: 100% checked decisive outputs and no proof/model mismatch.

technical_lanes.name: API_and_workflow_surface
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: Separate track leader result; never combine warm or incremental timings with the cold single-query score.

technical_lanes.name: component_local_migration
technical_lanes.next_falsifier: Recompute fixed-arm oracle headroom only after at least two new fixed engines pass; current measured headroom is 3.74%.
technical_lanes.promotion_gate: 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound at least 10%, selector balanced accuracy at least 0.80, and overhead below 1%.

compute_policy.local_mac: unit tests, generated bounded differentials, micro ABBA, dashboard generation
compute_policy.WMI: existing exact-revision PGO holdout and immutable historical campaign continuation

Helios.role: second CPU class, replicated fast-cycle and broad sharded campaigns
Helios.GPU_policy: No GPU timing claims for the single-core solver; GPUs may be used only for explicitly separated offline analysis whose cost is included or excluded by preregistration.

victory_contract.V0_validity: zero wrong answers, errors, missing rows, hash drift, and unchecked decisive outputs
victory_contract.V1_official_coverage: equal or exceed every comparator at every declared primary budget
victory_contract.V2_full_coverage: equal or exceed every comparator at 2, 60, and 1200 seconds
victory_contract.V3_time: at least 1.05x over every comparator in PAR2, common total, and common geometric wall time
victory_contract.V4_resources: no material p95 RSS regression and publish instructions/cache metrics on supported hosts
victory_contract.V5_generalization: same direction on two CPU classes and a sealed lineage-disjoint or external holdout
victory_contract.V6_quality: models and proofs independently checked, novelty ablated against closest prior art
